events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Fish's Fate

options.text: I knew I should have taken the monkey.

events.text: After a particularly merry feast, you wake to find the court's exotic fish missing from its pool. Our servants inform you that in a fit of madness you ordered the pet cooked and served. The horror!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Friendly Face

options.text: I do enjoy the little rascal.
I think I've had quite enough of this dog business.

events.text: Among all the bickering and deceit of the court, there is one fellow you have found whom you can always rely upon to tell no secrets and listen intently to your troubles. Your furry, wet nosed, occasionally stinky but always very happy to see you companion proves to be a stalwart and joyful friend throughout each and every day.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A New Target

options.text: Let [character] do his worst!
Whatever you want, just do not send the monkey!

events.text: A message arrives from [rival] in which [character] gloats over his capture of your notorious monkey assassin. "Give me what I desire, or I will send your little friend back to [rival] to deal with you." Who thought training a monkey assassin was a good idea? Oh, wait. You did.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Pawed Disaster

options.text: No! Bad Dog! Bad! No!
Who's a good doggy! Fetch!

events.text: One evening when you enter your chambers, you are greeted by the sight of your furry companion chewing upon the monkey's paw, which appears to have been irreparably ruined by the toothy encounter. The dog joyously drops the mangled chew thing at you feet and beams at you, as if to play fetch with it.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Animal Epitaphs

options.text: Put your heart and soul into words that do your resting companion justice.
Go for something simple, yet moving.
Good riddance.

events.text: Alas, time marches on, turning even the sweetest of moments into memories. Such is the case with your pet bird. As is only fitting, a statue has been raised in [city] to honor your deceased companion. The question remains of what words shall adorn the monument. How will your time with the feathered friend be memorialized?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Animals After Life

options.text: Then I will gladly forgo paradise.
Nothing will hold me back.

events.text: [character] eyes your dog before addressing you. “Such a companion may do well in this life, but they cannot follow into paradise. Would you sacrifice your own entry for this creature?”

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Camels and Paws

options.text: I must rid myself of this dear creature to sate [character].
There was no harm done to either party. The matter is settled.
I'm sure we can work out an arrangement.

events.text: In the middle of the day, your dog comes barreling through the court, caterwauling and whimpering as it runs between courtiers and skids on the stone floors. Gasps of exclamation fill the air as your dog charges across the room, leaps into your lap and spins around before dropping into your lap and licking your face affectionately. A harried servant rushes into the court. "My apologies, my [title]. The dog startled several camels. [character] was thrown from his camel and chased the dog across the courtyard." The servant bows again, distress plain upon their face. How shall we handle this matter?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Charming Monkey

options.text: He has proven to be both cute and useful.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has charmed the leaders of the [family] family. They have been much happier to pay visits to court since he became part of our royal menagerie.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Cuts Both Ways

options.text: Curse that monkey's paw.

events.text: Unbeknownst to you, a pair of prolific [rival] poets have been roaming the lands of [rival] and [rival], regaling their peoples with tales of your glory. [character] has become a character of popular culture, boosting your reputation far and wide. Of course, with this vast rise in awareness comes an equally vast rise in ill will. If your rivals among the vassal houses did not plot your death before, they certainly do now.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dagger-Wielding Monkey

options.text: This was a bad idea from the beginning.
Continue your reign of terror, my furry friend!

events.text: Shocking news from [rival]: [character] has been assassinated. However, the identity of the assassin is the most intriguing part of the story. Witnesses claim that the [title] was murdered by a screeching, dagger-wielding monkey! Clearly, someone has trained it to perform such heinous acts. You find it difficult to mask your reaction upon hearing the news.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Destructive Monkey

options.text: Bad monkey!
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey's behavior has gone from bad to worse. He escaped from the menagerie and made his way through the capital, inciting local wildlife. By the time he was recaptured, some of our city's finest improvements were in shambles.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Distracting Monkey

options.text: I cannot focus.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey proves very distracting. Whenever the court convenes, he screeches endlessly until you show him your complete attention. How long must this go on?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Doggy Diplomacy

options.text: Thank him for the generous compliments.
Use the opportunity to broker a peace.
Gift him with a pup from the military kennels.

events.text: During a rather intense series of negotiations with the leaders of the [tribe], you find yourself alone with [character]. At the sight of your furry companion leaning against your leg, a smile dances across [character]'s face and lights up his eyes. "I do so love dogs. May I?" With a nod from you, he bends down and strokes the fur of your companion. "My father told me that you can always trust a dog. They're a reflection of their owner. This is a good and happy dog, so I shall trust you as a friend."

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Doggy Diplomacy

options.text: Have your guards kill the others but leave [character] alive.
If you love the creature so much then you can have it.
I think I would rather hear the sounds of your villages burning.

events.text: During a rather intense series of negotiations with the leaders of the [tribe], you find yourself alone with [character]. At the sight of your furry companion hiding under a bench, growling, with a terrified look in its eyes, a sorrow filled frown darkens [character]'s face and hardens his eyes. "I do so love dogs. May I?" With a nod from you, he bends down and strokes the fur of your companion. "My father told me that you can always trust a dog. They're a reflection of their owner. This is a good dog, but cowed with fear. You must be a hard man, I can never trust you."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Eyes of the Monkey

options.text: No more monkey.

events.text: Late one evening, you hear a strange chittering from your private balcony. Going to investigate, you are attacked by a small, furry, adorable, dagger-wielding terror! It is the monkey - your monkey - now an agent and assassin of [rival]. As you lay dying, you stare into a pair of cold and vengeful eyes, cursing the day you ever plucked him from a traveling menagerie.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Fish at Rest

options.text: It was a good friend.

events.text: One evening, as you go to check on your new fish, you find it floating belly up. You comfort yourself, knowing that it had a good life. Better than most, actually.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Flocking Together

options.text: A friend of my bird is a friend of mine.
Bond over [character] odes.

events.text: [character] has taken an immense fondness of your pet bird, even writing an ode to the vivid creature. The time spent visiting the bird has warmed him to you, helping to thaw past grievances.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fowl Language

options.text: Give the bird a piece of your mind.
Release the bird for your peace of mind.
Hold it in.

events.text: Your pet bird has adopted some of your more choice language and taken to repeating the vulgar phrases at every hour, day and night. The relentless barrage of obscenities has you reaching for even deeper parts of your vocabulary.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Imprudent Monkey

options.text: But he is so ridiculously adorable.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey is starting to become a political liability. Courtiers worry that you spend too much time playing with him and not enough time governing. What will you tell them?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Inspiring Monkey

options.text: If it helps the troops, it helps the nation.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has started accompanying our generals on their military campaigns. The troops have adopted him as a sort of mascot, and his presence supposedly improves morale.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Instructive Monkey

options.text: I always knew he was smart.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has proven to be a revelation for court scientists. A top scholar has studied him, and her experiments are leading to new insights into animal behavior.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Legacy of the Paw

options.text: Curse that monkey's paw.

events.text: Distraught servants search the palace to find you. It is the heir, [character]! While playing in your chambers, he came across the monkey's paw, and he must have made a wish. You begin to feel faint, weak... Over the course of several days, the court declares your sudden sickness as reason enough for your abdication. [character] ascends the throne, his wish granted.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Lovely Fish

options.text: How calming.
I wonder how it tastes?

events.text: Sometimes, you catch yourself gazing at the court's new fish for hours on end...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Loyal Companion

options.text: Good dog.

events.text: A ferocious barking wakes you! Within minutes, the palace stirs from its slumber. Your trusty dog, with you since childhood, has cornered an armed stranger in the courtyard. It is an assassin from [rival] here to strike you down as you slept. The guards wrestle the fiend away, as you stroke your canine companion appreciatively.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Make a Wish

options.text: I wish for riches!
I wish for renown!
I wish for power!
Wait... I had better not. Burn it!

events.text: As the evening shadows fall, you hold the monkey's paw before the flickering hearth and make your plea. The flames rise and fall with the beating of your heart. Is that a monkey's grinning face you glimpse in the roaring fire, or is it only your imagination?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Monkey Medicine

options.text: I wish I were better!
No, I'll save my wish for another time.
I wish to be cured of the disease which is making me severely ill.

events.text: You feel sicker than you ever have in your life. Various wise people, healers, and priests have come and gone, leaving you no better. They all claim you will recover soon, but looking in their eyes you can see that they don’t really believe that. Perhaps it is time for more unconventional methods... perhaps that old monkey’s paw which is supposed to grant wishes could save you?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Monkey at Rest

options.text: Sadly, there will be no more monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has reached his end. Servants discovered him curled up on his favorite cushion, seemingly asleep. It took several minutes before they realized he had died.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Nonsense. Or Is It?

options.text: What harm could it do to try?
I should burn the beastly thing.
Tell the servant to return it to my quarters.

events.text: Late one evening, a servant approaches, carrying a small, hideous object between two fingers: the monkey's paw. The girl discovered it while cleaning the royal chambers. You had almost forgotten about the paw and its ridiculous legend. A magical wish... at a terrible cost. Nonsense. Or is it?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Open the Gates

options.text: Curse that monkey's paw.

events.text: News of an unexpected trade expedition greets you one morning, as crowds throng the gates of [city]. The expedition, thought lost, carries jewels, delicacies, and payments from foreign deals. Sadly, it is a day of mixed emotions. With the arrival of the expedition comes a strange sickness that infects workers across [city], slowing the harvest.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Paws and Tails

options.text: The dog shall be thrown from the palace.
It seems the monkey must go.
I shall accept your resignation.

events.text: You find yourself in a quandary. Your monkey and your dog torment each other, endlessly terrifying the servants in their mad escapades. Many of the palace servants have requested other assignments from the Chancellor, and he in turn requests that you deal with the creatures. "There simply isn't enough room in the kingdom for that pair of maniacs." [character] says, and blows an exasperated sigh. "You must choose which one to get rid of, or find yourself a new chancellor."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Persuasive Monkey

options.text: He has a gift for statecraft.
Return the regalia, and refuse the truce.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has engineered a diplomatic coup! When a delegation of [tribe] arrived to demand tribute, he snatched a piece of the high priest's regalia and presented it to them. The [family] family is furious, but the [tribe] agreed to call off their raiders. Who knew he was such a skilled negotiator?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Popular Monkey

options.text: May they sing his praises for eternity!
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey has inspired the imagination of the citizens! In the last few months, he has been the subject of poems, statues, and more than one popular drinking song.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Relaxing Fish

options.text: How pretty!

events.text: At times, when ruling proves stressful, you gaze at your beautiful new fish. Its movements calm you... make you hungry...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rise and Fall

options.text: Curse that monkey's paw.

events.text: In an unprecedented surge of national pride, record numbers of [rival] enlist in the military. Barracks and training grounds are overrun with recruits. The might of [rival] swells almost overnight. However, in a strange twist of fate, the heir to the throne, [character], develops a terrible fever that saps his strength and leaves him bedridden.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Scourge of [rival]

options.text: Apologize, and find that monkey and "retire" him.
I admit nothing. That monkey deserves a medal.
[rival] is simply jealous.

events.text: Our spies report rioting in the streets of [rival]! [character] was murdered as he slept, his throat cut with a tiny dagger - a dagger too small to be wielded by human hands. Only one killer carries such a weapon: your monkey assassin, the scourge of [rival]'s enemies.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Suspicious Monkey

options.text: Ignore him, and he will cease.
Train him to assassinate [character].
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey appears to harbor a grudge against the foreign leader [character]. Visiting the palace for a diplomatic visit, the [title] swears that he has caught the monkey shooting murderous glances at him. Perhaps we could capitalize on this?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Sword Cult Pilgrims

options.text: Build housing for these pilgrims.
Charge them a price to see it.

events.text: Pilgrims from all over [rival] arrive in [city] to view and venerate the mysterious sword. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tasty Fish

options.text: It is a good fish.
It might make a good supper.

events.text: Since considering the taste of your new fish, the question of what it would be like to eat continues to lurk in the back of your mind. But you would never act on it. Right?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Best Companion

options.text: Relax under a tree, petting your dog and watching the world pass by.
Spend the time running together, playing and hunting as you go.
Time to process and good company. Maybe things aren't so bad?

events.text: It is not easy being [title], but it helps knowing that your faithful dog is always there for you. Escaping the bickering and intrigue of court for a day, you take a walk, your cheerful dog excitedly exploring every new smell and sound before turning to check that you are still close.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Early Bird

options.text: “Guards!”
Take hold of your hidden dagger.

events.text: “CAW! WELCOME!” Many times have you lamented that the shrill scream of your pet bird does not match its elegant-looking exterior. However, on this day the abrasive shout is something to be thankful for; the greeting rips you from your sleep to find a startled [character] standing above you, dagger in hand.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Head in the Box

options.text: Well, he had a good run.
Declare a day of mourning in [rival].
I will settle for nothing short of vengeance.

events.text: A sorrowful shroud of mourning fills the court, and you wonder what has befallen your ministers and servants. It is the monkey... The elite guards of [character] discovered the furry assassin attempting to poison their ruler, and they dispatched it with haste, removing his adorable head from its shoulders. They returned his head to us in a box. It will be laid to rest with his legacy.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Thieving Monkey

options.text: The treasury could use the boost.
Return all the stolen items.
Enough monkey business.

events.text: Our adorable court monkey keeps getting into trouble. He steals jewelry from palace chambers and brings them to you as a gift. Our advisors are not pleased.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Tiny Paws

options.text: This was a bad idea from the beginning.
Continue your reign of terror, my furry friend!

events.text: Word of the brutal murder of [character] reaches the court, and ministers meet to discuss the repercussions of his death. The officer briefing us on [character]'s assassination mentions several perplexing details of the crime: tiny paw prints, an empty bottle of poison, a half-eaten date. It appears your loyal monkey assassin has struck!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Using the Sword

rewards.text: Gain trait: Sword of the Gods
tip: As general: +50% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry
As general: Immune to Critical Hit

options.text: I will wield it in battle.
I will put it on public display.
I will sell it to a wealthy collector.

events.text: What shall you do with your mysterious sword? It is a rare treasure, indeed.
